primary_source_checks.review: Checked source problem direction, spectral bound construction and distinction between heuristic and certified factor maxima.
Diagonal nonnegative multipliers, slope restriction, rho versus sqrt(rho), and increments were reviewed.

Scalar outputs, elementwise monotone activations, a.e. gradient-norm equality, mixed input norm and infinity norms, compact domain, and approximation rather than fixed exact architecture were checked.
Roesser realization size and minimality only for equal channels and full-rank terminal kernel were checked.
GroupSort block size, nonnegative lambda and free other block multipliers were checked.
Sparse PSD decomposition versus completion was checked: clique PSD blocks sum to the sparse matrix.

primary_source_checks.source: Delattre et al. ICML2023 primary PDF
primary_source_checks.locator: Theorem3; Appendix proof PDFp14 explicitly sigma1>sigma2
primary_source_checks.review: Universal upper bounds and convergence were separated from the superlinear rate, whose proof assumes a simple top singular value.

primary_source_checks.source: Kuang et al. primary arXiv v2 HTML
primary_source_checks.review: Compared fixed weights, bias-only variation, width scaling and explicit alternating-ReLU tail sum.
Nonsingular diagonal multiplier, similarity rather than symmetry of Q(T−WᵀW)Q⁻¹, Gershgorin sums and zero-column applicability were checked.
Compared certificate versus true Lipschitz class, Lambda=Psi², sandwich sqrt2 factors, completeness qualification and linear-layer case.
Checked storage inverse-Gramian formula, finite nilpotent series, fixed structure, Cholesky convention and nonsingular admissible gain factors.
Checked metric composition and detailed 2D Cayley–Gramian construction including positive epsilon and free/fixed parameter partition.
Checked diagonal multiplier, slope[0,1], well-posedness, strict contraction-rate inequality and the implicit/direct coordinate conversion.
Taylor remainder power/factorial was checked with page indexing m+1 versus paper first-k-terms indexing.

primary_source_checks.locator: Eq4 lines238–260; Theorem1 lines368–375; block definitions Eqs6–10
primary_source_checks.review: FastExp thresholds and epoch polar retraction match. The paper’s converse about all norm-preserving circular kernels needs extra support/grid assumptions; an exact finite-grid counterexample was independently found. Selected single-tap shifts remain certified.

Checked hard finite-prefix versus soft infinite-energy IQCs, zero filter state, common repeated channels/bounds for coupled terms, local containment and slice of augmented ellipsoid. The site already distinguishes source overgeneralizations.

primary_source_checks.locator: Section2.1, Theorem1 lines266–291, Theorems3–4 lines334–445, Section3.4
primary_source_checks.review: Checked augmented integral feedback, unique steady-state assumptions, network-output versus full-input deviation, local joint state/reference ellipsoid and governor feasibility.
Checked fixed uncertainty/supply parameters, full-order restriction, strict block [R I;I S] positivity, and equivalence to a certificate-feasible controller rather than every truly stable controller.
Checked stable base observer/controller, contracting and Lipschitz Q, realization scope for converse, and bounded-input approximation qualification.

primary_source_checks.locator: lines119–121 C is an infinity ball; Theorem3.3 lines380–425
primary_source_checks.review: Boundedness alone was found insufficient as stated; exact box setting and idealized exact bound optimization/exhaustive phase splitting now qualify completeness.

Checked disjunctive invariant sublevel condition, successor box containment and compactness argument from V tending to zero to convergence. Norm-exponential rate is explicitly not inferred without comparison bounds.

primary_source_checks.source: Noori et al. primary arXiv HTML
primary_source_checks.review: Compared coefficient sign freedoms, FIR window block orientation, hard prefixes, P semidefinite plus strict LMI and well-posedness.

primary_source_checks.locator: Assumption1 lines136–142; Definition2/Remark1 lines214–242; Lemma1/Theorem2 lines556–629
primary_source_checks.review: Checked incremental rho weights, monotonicity, squared gain gamma, matrix Xi/Gamma recursion, D inverse, reduced LMI block order and convergence without an asserted rate/boundedness shortcut.
Checked Bernoulli weight model, all-ones output, bias-free centered unit box, probability exponent, one-sided LP/SDP bounds and algebraic ratio.
Checked minimum coordinates, signs, half factors, centered optimal offset and l1/l2 comparison. The site already repairs the source’s lambda=0 division issue.

primary_source_checks.locator: Theorems1–2, Lemma3, Proposition2; Appendix restatements lines831–935
primary_source_checks.review: Checked strict radius, lower/upper probability ordering, Monte Carlo failure probability and finite-label normalization caveat for tightness; endpoint quantile and arbitrary-density domain refinements identified.
Checked unit-noise probit Lipschitz statement and sigma scaling; finite-real score excludes constant endpoint functions.
Checked fixed training rule, marginal experiment, exchangeability, ties qualification and upper rounding slack.
Checked separate training/calibration/test trajectories, infinity-appended finite-sample quantile and delta/T union bound for two distinct horizon events.
Checked feasibility/nonempty interior/existence/uniqueness, support dimension, fully-supported equality and iid product-space probability.
